window_discipline.baseline: 3 samples within 5 minutes; baseline_free = min(free); pilot_floor = baseline_free - 3072 MiB computed on the spot
window_discipline.monitor: monitor-until-clean.ps1 -Required 60 -MaxMinutes 30 -MaxUtil 40; window exists only if exit 0 AND longest_clean >= 60 AND all clean samples util < 40; exit != 0 (incl. built-in exit 20 = not ready within 30 min) means the window does NOT exist -> stop, report Chief, wait for a new token; not a pilot failure, no retry, no relaxation. The script's hard-coded 10,240 MiB free bound is only a lower bound; the operator still applies pilot_floor. New-Item the -OutCsv parent explicitly (the script auto-creates a missing parent at lines 31-34; line 30 only throws when there is no parent segment).
window_discipline.zero_compile: build before the window and record fingerprint; no cargo/nvcc inside the window
window_discipline.exception: authoring exception util<60 does not apply; a failed regular threshold stops the pilot and reports
window_discipline.fail_stop: keep evidence, clean only the pilot temp tree, no retry, no threshold change, no commit
